title: Houston Taiwanese Golden Club 休士頓台灣清閒俱樂部
content_html: The Houston Taiwanese Golden Club is a nonprofit, nonpolitical, and nonreligious autonomous organization founded on December 12, 1998. It operates on the principle of ‘from the members, for the members,’ with the goal of benefiting members and fostering fellowship among Taiwanese compatriots in the Houston area. Membership is open to individuals aged 50 and above who are originally from Taiwan, with annual dues of $30 for couples and $15 for individuals. Activities include travel, outings, sports, dancing, music appreciation, karaoke, cuisine, gardening, and lectures on health, medicine, finance, and technology. The club is based at the Taiwanese Community Center.
